instructions: NetCrux reads a hardware design as Yosys elaborates it: Verilog, SystemVerilog or VHDL sources, a Yosys JSON netlist, or a .crux-project. Call info first, search for the full name of a cell, net, port or module, connections for one step of wiring, cone (Pro) for what drives or is driven to a depth, trace_x (Pro) for a structural candidate source of X, never a proven cause. Names are hierarchical, dot-separated, rooted at the top module. Cite each finding with the link in its location, which opens it in NetCrux for a person to check, or with its source line.

tools.name: info
tools.description: Elaborate a design and return its top module, hierarchy and cell and net counts.

design.description: Source files, one Yosys JSON netlist, or one .crux-project.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Find cells, nets, ports or modules by name in an elaborated design. Each hit carries its source line.

design.description: Source files, one Yosys JSON netlist, or one .crux-project.

tools.name: connections
tools.description: One step of connectivity within a module: for a cell, its pins and the net on each; for a net, the pins that drive it and the pins it drives.

design.description: Source files, one Yosys JSON netlist, or one .crux-project.

tools.name: cone
tools.description: Pro. The cone of influence of a cell or net within its module: the cells that drive it (fanin) or that it drives (fanout), to a depth. Structural; reads no waveform.

design.description: Source files, one Yosys JSON netlist, or one .crux-project.

tools.name: trace_x
tools.description: Pro. Walk back from a net along one driver route to a structural source of X: an undriven or x-tied input, or a register with no reset and no initial value. Reads no waveform, so it names a candidate, not a proven cause.

design.description: Source files, one Yosys JSON netlist, or one .crux-project.
